name: comp-158
blurb: Radio group where each option is a colored swatch for selecting a color.
description: Fieldset with 7 colored radio buttons (blue, indigo, pink, red, orange, amber, emerald). Each swatch is 6x6 sized with full-color fill. Blue is pre-selected.
use_when: Color picker interfaces, theme selection, or product variant selection by color.
avoid_when: Accessibility—color alone doesn't convey meaning. Ensure aria-labels are present.
a11y: Each swatch has aria-label naming the color. Fieldset with legend provides context. Full keyboard navigation. Focus ring visible.
